label: US-CO-HB26-1139-healthAI-UR-2026 SECTION 3

obligations.text: A PAYER OF MENTAL OR BEHAVIORAL HEALTH-CARE SERVICES PROVIDED UNDER THE "COLORADO MEDICAL ASSISTANCE ACT", AS SPECIFIED IN ARTICLES 4, 5, AND 6 OF THIS TITLE 25.5, OR THE "CHILDREN'S BASIC HEALTH PLAN ACT", AS SPECIFIED IN ARTICLE 8 OF THIS TITLE 25.5, SHALL NOT PAY FOR SERVICES THAT CONSTITUTE PSYCHOTHERAPY SERVICES, AS DEFINED IN SECTION 12-245-202 (14), THAT ARE PROVIDED DIRECTLY TO AN INDIVIDUAL AND THAT ARE CONDUCTED BY AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM, AS THAT TERM IS DEFINED IN SECTION 10-16-112.7 (1)(b).
